holds: Only the existing TPL-07 exact operational review preparer is executable in this revision.
Other content and all evaluation lanes require their real request preparers and eligibility checks before delegated admission.
The allocation is a maximum additional spend, not a guarantee of completing every permitted attempt.

expirySemantics: The owner-approved record fixes its expiry. Every child expires no later than its parent and retained review plan. Revocation stops every new dispatch, including already reserved work. Valid in-flight usage is still accounted.
scopeNotice: One up-to-$30 additional inference allocation for 108 actual content units (70 canonical intake IDs plus 12 practical guides, 20 industry landing sections and six deeper packs) and the original 80/60/60 case rosters. Named sections use actual source headings, not invented runtime UUIDs. Same-identity candidate revisions still require real eligibility checks; original evaluation corpus bytes stay pinned. Prior unknown charges, tax, Agent usage, hosting and other projects are excluded. Completion of all allowed work is not promised.
delegationNotice: Once this package is actually approved, the server may admit exact immutable submanifests within its scope without asking for per-item spending or publication approval. Current implementation only prepares the original TPL-07 operational pair.
